# Overview

This learning lab follows the complete workflow from REDCap API access through secure data extraction.

::: {.overview-grid}

::: {.overview-card}
### 1. Enable API access

Request a project-specific REDCap API token.
:::

::: {.overview-card}
### 2. Store the token securely

Keep credentials outside the code and project directory.
:::

::: {.overview-card}
### 3. Call REDCap

Use the R or SAS example to retrieve the report.
:::

::: {.overview-card}
### 4. Reuse and automate

Save unchanged extracts to `DataRaw` and support repeatable runs.
:::

:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Design principle

Credentials stay separate from the code and extracted data.
:::

# How to use this training

Work through the training sections in order.

When you reach the extraction examples, choose the path that matches the software you use:

- **R:** `Code/01_get_redcap_R.R`
- **SAS:** `Code/01_get_redcap_sas.sas`

Complete example programs are available on the **Code & Downloads** page. You will be able to view and copy the code directly from the website or download the original files.
